# OM-5 Mark II 1.1 English in the Japanese slot, resource-only r01

Replacing only component 0101 points the Japanese slot at English text; one owner reports English menus on a Japanese-market body.

**Camera:** [OM SYSTEM OM-5 Mark II](../cameras/om5-ii.md) · **Project:** [OM-5 Mark II JP English research](../projects/om5-ii-jp-english.md)

**Firmware:** [om5-ii firmware 1.1, build 1100](../firmware/om5-ii-1100.md) · **Mod build:** r01 resource-only (82aebb31…)

On a native OM-5 Mark II on official 1.1, a component-0101-only update whose Japanese string descriptor selects an English-based table gives English menus in the Japanese language slot, with no code or region change.

**Availability:** research. **Implementation basis:** reported.

## Supporting observations

- [OM-5 Mark II JP English r01: one owner's camera](../evidence/om5-ii-jp-english-r01.md) — physical camera; reported pass; partial report; reported hash.

## Limits

- One owner-reported camera; the checked subset of functions was not recorded and every menu item has not been checked.
- The 39 gap translations are the researchers' own, not OMDS text; their wording and layout need review.
- Recovery after a damaged 0101 resource and the SD updater's availability then are unknown.
- Not for the original OM-5 (E144), OM-5 ports or any other build; the input must match the exact stock digest.
